categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the Tests label and edits shared unit test utilities in src/test/util/mining.cpp and src/test/util/mining.h.
categories.rationale: Consolidates and hardens test utility logic for rebuilding block templates against arbitrary parents to prevent future tests from generating silently invalid blocks. As noted in the description, existing callers already worked around or avoided these issues, making this a proactive improvement to shared testing helpers rather than a fix for an active CI failure.
